name_to_fear.label: A Name to Fear
name_to_fear.description: Make the crew's name a threat in itself: people pay rather than fight.
name_to_fear.bonus_text: Raids and assaults +10%; demands for tribute 20% likelier to be paid

good_neighbours.label: Good Neighbours
good_neighbours.description: Keep your word and your borders quiet, and let everyone see it.
good_neighbours.bonus_text: Treaties 15% likelier to be accepted; every neighbour thinks 10 better of you

open_for_trade.label: Open for Trade
open_for_trade.description: Stalls, safe roads and fair weights: make your land the place to trade.

walls_and_watches.label: Walls and Watches
walls_and_watches.description: After the last attack, nobody sleeps unguarded again.
walls_and_watches.bonus_text: Attacks on all your districts x0.9; Watchtowers build in half the time

feed_the_city.label: Feed the City
feed_the_city.description: Gardens on every roof and a kitchen on every street.

salvage_rights.label: Salvage Rights
salvage_rights.description: Organised crews, marked ruins and tools that don't break.

a_city_again.label: A City Again
a_city_again.description: Plan streets, not shelters: build to last.
a_city_again.bonus_text: +1 building slot in every Secured district

loyal_lieutenants.label: Loyal Lieutenants
loyal_lieutenants.description: Bind the council to the leader with oaths, shares and favours.
loyal_lieutenants.bonus_text: The council's loyalty +10 for good; the chance of a split at a succession x0.75

welfare_for_all.label: Welfare for All
welfare_for_all.description: Nobody goes without: food, shelter and care shared out fairly.
welfare_for_all.bonus_text: Grievance falls 0.05 a day in all your districts; unlocks the Politburo reform

strongmans_crown.label: The Strongman's Crown
strongmans_crown.description: One leader, one line: make the leader's word the law and the heir certain.
strongmans_crown.bonus_text: The heir's claim +20; unlocks the Autocracy reform

charter_the_guilds.label: Charter the Guilds
charter_the_guilds.description: Give the traders seats, rules and a stake in the crew.
charter_the_guilds.bonus_text: Trade income +10%; unlocks the Merchant Oligarchy reform
